messages:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: [sev=2] euc2-nlb: sudden spike in downstream connection resets for HTTP/2 -> paging oncall @Sam
Sam (oncall): on it, pulling dashboards and logs. which svc is the majority of errors?
Priya (sre): ml-inference-svc fronted by envoy in euc2. large uptick in h2 stream resets and 502s starting ~2765431980. sample error snippet:
```
{"upstream": "10.0.45.12:8080", "response_code": 502, "error": "stream reset", "protocol": "h2"}
```
Priya (sre): spike covers azb + azc, p95 latency unchanged for successful requests but error rate for /v1/infer and /v1/embed ~12% last 6m.
Jordan (infra): I pushed an NLB change ~7m ago to enable proxy-protocol v2 to support downstream h2 proxying. Rolling back to previous config now (suspect proxy->h2 handshake mismatch).
Sam (oncall): ack. Priya — can you list customer impact and scale?
Priya (sre): roughly 600 rps from euc2, affected customers include two paying tenants and internal integration tests (CS alerted). estimated user-facing errors ~200/min at peak.
PagerDuty: paging Sam via phone.
Sam (oncall): mitigation plan A = rollback NLB proxy-protocol option and restart nlb-proxy agents. Plan B = route traffic away from euc2 via weighted DNS if rollback doesn't clear within 5-10m.
Jordan (infra): executing rollback now. commands i'm running:
```
aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:targetgroup/tg-ml-inference --attributes Key=proxy_protocol_v2.enabled,Value=false
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/nlb-proxy-config
```
Jordan (infra): applied change at 2765432160, waiting for target health to settle.
Priya (sre): envoy upstream logs show stream resets decreasing in azb but azc still noisy. sample log:
```
[2026-03-15T07:56:12Z] grpc: stream error: code=2 desc=\"upstream reset by peer\"
```
Sam (oncall): start soft-failover prep in parallel: we'll shift 40% of api traffic from euc2 to euc1 via Route53 weights. Jordan — do you have dns perms?
Jordan (infra): yes applying change. route53 command (applied):
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZZZ --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood-inference.internal.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"euc1-weight","Weight":40,"TTL":60,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"10.1.2.3"}]}}]}'
```
Jordan (infra): change applied at 2765432290. monitoring: euc2 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> ~3% within ~40s of shift.
Priya (sre): customer impact reduced, but be aware of session affinity and streaming clients — some may re-establish connections and see higher latency. CS should notify impacted tenants.
Maya (cs): notified the two paying tenants and opened support tickets; sending templated message and ETA for update.
Sam (oncall): good. OpsBot: please create incident-2765432100 doc and set state to "mitigation in progress".
OpsBot: Incident state updated -> mitigation in progress. Incident record: incident-2765432100.
Priya (sre): post-mitigation checklist: 1) RCA owners = Priya & Jordan 2) add NLB/h2 canary test + automated rollback 3) update runbook for weighted DNS shift and customer comms.
Jordan (infra): agree. I'll revert the proxy flag change from rollout history and add preflight tests for proxy-proto + h2.
Sam (oncall): keeping channel open for 1h monitoring. if errors hold <1% we close. tagging owners for RCA and follow-up.
PagerDuty: incident acknowledged; escalation closed after mitigation.
Sam (oncall): final note: residual 1% errors concentrated in azc; investigating deeper but overall customer impact largely mitigated. moving to "watching". :white_check_mark:
